## About this report

- Period: September 2026 (one month) (1–30 Sep 2026), compared with August 2026 (1–31 Aug 2026) and September 2025 (1–30 Sep 2025, the same period a year earlier).
- Written commentary; all figures come from the data below.
- Sources: Google Search Console (search), Google Analytics 4 (organic traffic), saved site audits, the Chrome UX Report and Google Tag Manager when those sections are included.
- Search Console counts anonymized queries in its totals but not in the query tables, so the query tables don't add up to the totals.
- Not included this time (no data for this period): Tracked keyword rank trends.
